title: The mapping-cone spectral object of the decalage tower
statement: For any abelian category C, construct a functor from filtered integer cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration] to abelian spectral objects. Its increasing EInt tower is zero at minus infinity, Dec(F)^(1-q) at an integer q, and K at plus infinity [lem-sp-filtered-complex-decalage]. Apply the actual mapping-cone spectral object of the homotopy category and its homology functor. Filtered maps restrict uniquely through the monic step inclusions. Accompanying proved APIs identify interval cohomology with the cokernel quotient cohomology naturally, and characterize maps to a decalage step by their shifted filtration images.
